API CHOICES (design latitude):
- withholding_constants: RAW_SHA256 is dict[Path(abs) -> sha]. Pins file = JSON LIST of entries (oldest first); read_pins() helper added; append_pin rewrites atomically (tmp + os.replace) and calls assert_writable_target. assert_writable_target raises RuntimeError. parse_amendment_rows(protocol_path=None) reads PROTOCOL at call time; also raises ValueError on a missing separator row or two amendments tables. code_sha256 skips listed paths that are not regular files (tracked-but-deleted). group_ok_valid returns False on any missing/unreadable file.
- go_relation: GoRelationTable(ids, annotated, sim, source_meta) keeps NO index reference (no .index attr); extra helpers __len__, __contains__, n_annotated(). go_relation_loss returns ids = deduplicated batch proteins FOUND in the table (annotated or not); these feed loss_engine.go_relation_seen_ids. Missing embedding key -> KeyError (becomes fatal via the guard).
- loss_engine: weight validated as 0.0 <= w < inf (rejects NaN/inf/negative; no new 'import math' line). Four methods added (set_go_relation_table, _go_relation_loss, _with_go_relation, go_ordinal_components) - the design lists four signatures although its prose says 'five'. go_relation import is lazy inside the methods (contrastive_learning keeps no import-time dependency on go_ppi_domain). Methods placed between compute_loss and _compute_go_ordinal_loss (insertions).
- withholding_diagnostics: also exports projection_param_summary(trainer) -> {names, numel} and negative_selection_block(recorder, selector) -> the exact design 4.7 'negative_selection' dict (FEAT-003 runner should use both for lc_manifest). StrictEpochGuard appends the epoch record BEFORE raising; message 'StrictEpochGuard[<cell>] epoch <e>: ...'. EpochDiagnostics: rows also kept in .rows; 'drift_flag' key is ALWAYS present (bool); if relation_table=None it lazily builds GoRelationTable.from_train_file(config.go_index_cache, train_file) on first call (runner may pass a prebuilt one, but it must be a separate object from the loss engine's). Samples are built lazily on first call with GoPpiRecordAdapter(trainer.config).
- DEVIATION (keeps design intent): trainer._generate_embeddings calls self.model.train() before projecting, which would silently re-enable dropout (projection_dropout 0.3) during the 'eval-mode' diagnostics pass. EpochDiagnostics pins eval mode by shadowing model.train with an instance-level no-op for the pass and deletes it in finally (test asserts 'train' not in vars(model) and model.training restored). No trainer edit.
- run_learning_curve_point: attach_go_relation_loss(trainer, config, train_file) returns {'weight':0.0,'table':None} at weight 0; else {'weight','table_proteins','annotated_proteins','table_sha256','index_leak_pruning'}. ValueError on domain != go_ppi. No CLI change.
